purpose: Teach: たちまち/因みに/御覧/益々/まわる/向う/ちび/ちょいと

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが帰宅されたらたちまちお家が明るくなるわね
lines.en: Sho, your father's arrival really does brighten up this whole house, doesn't it.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Gentle cadence. A small smile in the voice. Speaking from affection and long knowing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、因みに今日のおやつが楽しみだよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm looking forward to snack time today, by the way.
lines.style: Bright, conversational. The 'by the way' is a tangent he genuinely just thought of. Eager but not loud. A child sharing what matters to him in the moment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「御覧の通り」と仰りながら絵本を見せて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father shows you picture books and says things like 'as you can see'—so thoughtfully.
lines.style: Affectionate observation. Slight warmth on the word 'thoughtfully'. Not a complaint, an admiration. Speaking as someone watching her child be loved.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが益々頼もしいよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad seems more and more reliable to me.
lines.style: Genuine wonder in his voice. Not performance—real discovery that his father is someone he can count on. Quiet conviction for a six-year-old.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、おもちゃの車をまわるのを止めてね
lines.en: Sho, stop spinning that toy car around now.
lines.style: Gentle but clear direction. Not sharp. A mother's quiet firmness—the kind that expects to be listened to without needing to raise her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが向うのお家までお迎えに行ってくれるって
lines.en: Mom, Dad said he'd pick me up from the house across the way.
lines.style: Excited announcement. Quick tempo. The simple pride of a child reporting something his father promised. No doubts—just pleased fact-sharing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ちびっ子だからって油断は禁物よ
lines.en: Sho, don't get careless just because you're small—you need to be careful.
lines.style: Practical concern beneath gentleness. A mother's protective vigilance. Steady tone, not anxious. The kind of caution that comes from love, not fear.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ちょいと外を見て来るね
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to go look outside for a bit.
lines.style: Bright, casual farewell. A child's natural restlessness. Quick, uncomplicated. The tone of someone about to go do something small and ordinary.
